description: This file defines the SkipOnEmpty class, a Drupal migration process plugin that skips processing or rows when input values are empty. It includes methods for handling row skipping and property processing based on emptiness, and references external Drupal migrate classes and exceptions.

classes.name: SkipOnEmpty
classes.description: A Drupal migration process plugin class that skips rows or properties when input values are empty.

methods.name: row
methods.description: Skips the current row if the input value is empty, throwing a MigrateSkipRowException with an optional message.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Stops processing the current property if the input value is empty, returning NULL.
